name: LiveOIBench
description: LiveOIBench is a comprehensive benchmark of 403 expert-curated Olympiad-level competitive programming problems with extensive test cases and elite contestant performance data, designed to evaluate LLM coding capabilities at a high difficulty level.
reputation: A very recent Olympiad-level coding benchmark with expert-curated problems, likely to become a strong test of advanced coding agents but not yet broadly established.
notes: Features contamination-free updates, detailed subtask rubrics, and a self-contained evaluation system facilitating offline assessments.
